findings.evidence: GeneratorRelations.lean:195 `(CartanMatrix.B (n + 1)).transpose i j • typeBSimpleRootGenerator j`; GeneratorRelations.lean:207 same form; SerreRelations.lean:237 and 252 use `-CartanMatrix.B (n + 1) j i`.
findings.fix: Write the exponent as `(-(CartanMatrix.B (n + 1)).transpose i j).toNat` in both public theorems (and the two private matrix-level lemmas at lines 132 and 214), matching `typeBSimpleCorootGenerator_lie_root`; the transpose is then visible in the statement and the explanatory docstring sentence at line 230 becomes unnecessary.
findings.issue: The exponent is written `(-CartanMatrix.B (n + 1) j i).toNat`, with the binders reversed, while the adjacent Cartan-action API in the same directory writes the same transposed matrix as `(CartanMatrix.B (n + 1)).transpose i j` (GeneratorRelations.lean:195, 207). Two spellings of one matrix across the two files that a follow-up must assemble into a single `IsSerreSystem`; read on its own, `B (n+1) j i` in a theorem whose binders are `(i j)` reads as an index slip rather than a convention.

findings.fix: Reword both to e.g. "as a difference of two scalar multiples of matrix units", or state the coefficients, as the definition's own docstring already does ("adapted to the middle coefficient `2`", line 157). `typeBLongRootMatrix_def` (line 69) is accurate as written.
findings.issue: Docstring of `typeBShortRootMatrix_def` says "a difference of two matrix units", but the right-hand side is `single (.inr (.inl i)) (.inl ()) 2 - single (.inl ()) (.inr (.inr i)) 1` — the first term is twice a matrix unit, not a matrix unit. Same wording on `typeBShortNegativeRootMatrix_def` (line 174), whose first term also has coefficient 2 (line 177).

summary: Names largely follow in-repo precedent (`ad_pow_lie_serreE_serreE`, `lie_serreE_serreF_of_ne`), but the new statements spell the transposed type-B Cartan matrix with swapped indices while the sibling file in the same directory spells it `.transpose i j`, and two new `_def` docstrings call a scalar multiple of a matrix unit a matrix unit.
